editorial.blurb: Chengdu Impression brings authentic Sichuan heat and bold flavors to Edgewater, with standout dishes like Kung Pao chicken and chili wontons that deliver real spice.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the chili wontons and Kung Pao chicken for dine-in to experience them at their best; the spicy chicken tastes noticeably better fresh rather than takeout. Rice is ordered separately, so plan ahead.
